sources.q10: Median Q10 of the vegetables with derived values (no usable respiration data)
sources.sl_ref_hours: Cold-storage life 1440-2160 h at 11.5 C (10-13 C), converted to 25 C with Q10; https://www.ars.usda.gov/arsuserfiles/oc/np/commercialstorage/commercialstorage.pdf
sources.alpha: Median alpha of the vegetables calibrated on NABCONS 2022; no loss row for this crop
sources.second_life: Processing: preserved pulp (KMS / benzoate, 6 months), pulp for jams, sauces, instant mixes (https://phytojournal.com/archives/2018/vol7issue4/PartP/7-3-752-678.pdf); Recover: biogas, compost (D19)
sources.water_l_per_kg: Mekonnen and Hoekstra 2010, Report 47, global average, row 'Pumpkins, squash and gourds', https://www.waterfootprint.org/resources/Report47-WaterFootprintCrops-Vol1.pdf
